create_dummy_frame: create a dummy video frame with a moving circle and corner labels for homography visualization
visualize_homography: visualize homography augmentation by generating a GIF of augmented dummy frames
run_homography_visualization_cli: run the homography visualization CLI to generate a GIF at a specified output path
test_homography_augmentation: test the homography augmentation on dummy video frames and verify output
review_visualize_homography: review the visualize_homography function and its homography augmentation pipeline
